title: Exact frame prices exclude 3,083,991,930 Gaussian assignments at κ = 0.0039
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

At κ = 0.0039, every allowed change to one internal or helper-only chart, or any pair of purely internal charts, leaves the Gaussian raw price equal or worse. The count is 3,083,991,930 strict losses and 172 ties including the identity. The baseline deficit already exceeds 1.539342547620186178214 per unscaled call. The proof fixes main endpoints, all normalized rational forms, 5,674 ordered paid transfers and their strict positive-grade incidence. It counts every admissible binary subspace in each declared family and includes all affected productive helper grades. It excludes zero-grade contractions, coupled helper changes and changes of the main public interface from its domain.

## Task and overlap

This refines the scalar-to-moment card to geometric frames at a specific trial. ToikY’s [#8072](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8072) at `75f7e1c44f48c43983016bcf8878c4d9e5e87c62` and [#8073](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8073) at `cf4c4b7ea4b746be174ee4ba4e49f03b5bc79f8e` independently regenerate the identical scientific projection. [#8074](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8074) addresses linear information and different donor routes. Earlier #7124 and #7131 change a public interface under another contract. The historical package guide and CI repair are shared at parent `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026`.

## Validation

Ran `python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-gaussian-frame-price` on a fresh 15-file export in 3.29 seconds. The verifier checks the price inequalities, all class counts and the absolute phase on all 72 changed signed operators. It compares all 512 columns for one changed transfer and rejects an incorrect phase. A separate full-source replay installed all 18 neutral replacements together and verified 1,291 source columns, 88,780,788 adjoint terms, 2,971 directed pairs and 104 port adapters. The same projection regenerated byte-for-byte from both external heads.

## Credit and open next question

ToikY supplied the reference signed allocations, Ali Romman the Gaussian graph and supplier, SYLforge the ordinary K7 circuit, and Rohan Arun the earlier public output rechart. The package retains the source licenses. Clear1nsight used OpenAI Codex for research, implementation, checking and writing. A next test is a jointly changed main boundary and its physical adapter, with every changed paid and productive rank carried through the native return. This finite exclusion contributes no new complete κ by itself.
